PLAN "21-Day Powerlifting Peak"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Peak squat, bench, deadlift for competition"

PHASES
  PHASE "Week 1: Volume Taper" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          running 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x3 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          squat 3x2 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 3x3 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Bench Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x3 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x2 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x3 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s
      DAY Friday training 60m "Deadlift Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x2 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x1 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x3 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          back_extension 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          back_stretch 60s

  PHASE "Week 2: Intensity Hold, Volume Drop" (1 week):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Squat Opener":
        warmup:
          running 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x2 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          squat 2x1 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          squat 1x1 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Bench Opener":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x2 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 2x1 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 1x1 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s
      DAY Friday training 50m "Deadlift Opener":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 8.5 rest 180 seconds
          back_extension 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          back_stretch 60s

  PHASE "Week 3: Meet Prep & Taper" (1 week):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Squat Technique":
        warmup:
          running 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x1 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          squat 1x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Bench Technique":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x1 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 1x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Light Movement":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_curl 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          back_stretch 60s
      DAY Saturday training 40m "Deadlift Technique":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          back_stretch 60s

goals.name: Peak squat, bench, deadlift for competition
